content: NovaPay Solutions Ltd offers cross-border and local payment gateway APIs. Standard transaction fees are 1.4% for domestic transactions capped at 2,000 NGN, and 3.8% plus 100 NGN for international transactions with no cap. Account maintenance and API sandbox integration are free of charge.

Payout and settlement schedules for verified merchants occur on a strict T+1 business day basis for domestic local currency (NGN) transactions. International payouts are settled on a T+3 business day basis in USD or EUR. Weekend and public holiday transactions are processed on the subsequent operating business banking day.

To complete merchant onboarding, companies must submit CAC documents, TIN, valid director ID, and utility bills. The turnaround time for Tier 1 verification is 24 to 48 business hours once all valid documentation is submitted.

Merchants have a strict 72-hour regulatory window from notification to accept or contest a customer chargeback. Required contest evidence includes proof of delivery, signed invoices, and customer transaction logs submitted via the NovaPay merchant dispute dashboard. Contested disputes are arbitrated within 14 business days.

Merchants can issue full or partial customer refunds directly through the NovaPay dashboard or the /v1/refunds REST API endpoint. Refunds take 3 to 5 business days to credit back to the customer's funding card or bank account. Processing gateway fees charged on the initial transaction are non-refundable.

All merchant webhook endpoints must verify incoming JSON payload authenticity using HMAC SHA512 signatures passed in the 'X-NovaPay-Signature' header against the merchant secret key. Receiving endpoints must return an immediate HTTP 200 OK within 5 seconds. API requests are rate-limited to 120 requests per minute per live API key.

NovaPay supports merchant multi-currency collection across NGN, USD, GBP, and EUR. Merchants can hold balances in separate currency wallets or auto-convert to primary local currency at real-time interbank rates plus a 1.2% foreign exchange conversion spread.

NovaPay platform architecture is certified under PCI-DSS Level 1 service provider standards and ISO/IEC 27001 security compliance. All sensitive cardholder data is tokenized inside hardware security modules (HSM) with AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit.

NovaPay Solutions provides end-to-end digital payment infrastructure for merchants. Core services include: 1) Multi-channel payment gateway (cards, bank transfers, USSD), 2) Automated merchant settlement and payouts (T+1 domestic, T+3 international), 3) Tiered KYC onboarding and merchant compliance, 4) Dispute and chargeback management with a 72-hour resolution window, and 5) Secure RESTful webhook API integrations enforced by HMAC SHA-256 signatures and PCI-DSS Level 1 certification.
